verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents a public JSON API on formulae.brew.sh that returns `brew info --json` data. That is a data endpoint, not a downloadable machine-readable description of the API, and probes of the usual OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The JSON API is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
